## Institution facts
- SABER College is a nonprofit postsecondary institution founded in 1972 in Miami, Florida.
- Address: 3990 West Flagler Street, Suite 103, Miami, FL 33134.
- Contact: +1-305-443-9170; saber@sabercollege.edu.
